army_rules.name: Thrill Seekers
army_rules.rules_text: If your Army Faction is EMPEROR'S CHILDREN, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, but when doing so: it cannot target a unit it was within Engagement Range of at the start of the turn; it cannot target a unit that was the target of another unit's charge or attacks this phase.

army_rules.name: Pact of Excess
army_rules.rules_text: When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select LEGIONS OF EXCESS as your Army Faction.

rule.name: Quicksilver Grace
rule.rules_text: You can re-roll Advance rolls made for EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units from your army.

enhancements.name: Steeped in Suffering
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If that target is also Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

enhancements.name: Intoxicating Musk
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. Each time a melee attack targets the bearer's unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Tactical Perfection
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to two EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Loathsome Dexterity
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.name: Violent Excess
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: Combat Stimms
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Honour the Prince
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Dark Vigour
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army (excluding BEASTS and VEHICLES) that is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Capricious Reactions
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Cruel Raiders
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within 3" horizontally of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

rule.name: Exquisite Swordsmanship
rule.rules_text: Each time an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, select one of the abilities below. While resolving those attacks, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability: [LETHAL HITS]; [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

options.name: Exquisite Swordsmanship - Lethal Hits
options.rules_text: When this unit made a Charge move this turn and is selected to fight, melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

options.name: Exquisite Swordsmanship - Sustained Hits
options.rules_text: When this unit made a Charge move this turn and is selected to fight, melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Faultless Opportunist
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that Stratagem this phase. If you do, that use is -1CP. That use does not prevent any uses of that Stratagem on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Blinding Speed
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Distortion
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Rise to the Challenge
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per battle, at the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of three or more enemy models, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer can fight one additional time. When doing so, you can select one ability using the Exquisite Swordsmanship Detachment rule to apply to those attacks.

stratagems.name: Deft Parry
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Death Ecstasy
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Incessant Violence
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army Consolidates.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends that Consolidation move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Cruel Bladesman
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

stratagems.name: Terrifying Spectacle
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Command phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move in the previous turn and destroyed one or more enemy units in the previous Fight phase.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if they are Below Half-strength. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

stratagems.name: Cut Down the Weak
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army (you can only select it if it is a WALKER) that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select that enemy unit as a target of that charge, and your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.

rule.name: Mechanised Murder
rule.rules_text: Each time an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model from your army makes an attack, if it is a TRANSPORT model or disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 or re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Sublime Prescience
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per turn, in your Movement phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN TRANSPORT that is in Strategic Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that TRANSPORT on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Spearhead Striker
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Each time the bearer disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit and enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Accomplished Tactician
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per turn, in your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, you can select one friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit within 9" of the bearer that was hit by one or more of those attacks, then select one friendly TRANSPORT that unit is wholly within 6" of and is able to embark within. That EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit can embark within that Transport.

enhancements.name: Heretek Adept
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for a friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN VEHICLE model within 6" of the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

stratagems.name: Onto the Next
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that destroyed an enemy unit this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
stratagems.effect: If your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it. Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from a TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: Advance and Claim
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that has one or more TORMENTORS units embarked within it (excluding Battle-shocked units).
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your TRANSPORT is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Dynamic Breakthrough
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.name: Ceaseless Onslaught
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this turn.
stratagems.effect: Your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit is treated as having made an Assault disembark move (Core Rules, 1806) for that disembarkation.

stratagems.name: Reactive Disembarkation
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Outflanking Strike
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army, or up to two EMPEROR'S CHILDREN DEDICATED TRANSPORTS from your army.
stratagems.effect: For each of those TRANSPORTS wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

detachments.name: Carnival of Excess

rule.name: Daemonic Empowerment
rule.rules_text: While an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly LEGIONS OF EXCESS units, it is Empowered. While a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units, it is Empowered. While a unit from your army is Empowered, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If such a weapon already has that ability, each time an attack is made with that weapon, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

additional_rules.name: Legions of Excess
additional_rules.rules_text: You can include LEGIONS OF EXCESS units in your army, even though they do not have the EMPEROR'S CHILDREN Faction keyword. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is: Incursion: Up to 500 pts; Strike Force: Up to 1000 pts; Onslaught: Up to 1500 pts. No LEGIONS OF EXCESS models from your army can be your WARLORD.

restrictions: No LEGIONS OF EXCESS models from your army can be your WARLORD.

enhancements.name: Empyric Suffusion
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, that use is -1CP.

enhancements.name: Dark Blessings
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per battle, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has a 3+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Possessed Blade
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. At the start of the battle, select one melee weapon equipped by the bearer; add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon. In addition, each time the bearer is selected to fight, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, while resolving those attacks, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that weapon and that weapon has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and [HAZARDOUS] abilities.

enhancements.name: Warp Walker
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN or KEEPER OF SECRETS model only. Each time the bearer's unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
restrictions: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN or KEEPER OF SECRETS model only.

stratagems.name: Sustained By Agony
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit within 6" of your unit. One model in that LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit recovers up to 3 lost wounds or, if it is a DAEMONETTES unit, return up to D3+3 destroyed models to it instead.

stratagems.name: Ecstatic Slaughter
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit and one friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit within 6" of it that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit can declare a charge. If it does so and it has already been selected to fight this phase, it cannot fight again this phase.

stratagems.name: Violent Crescendo
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One SLAANESH BEASTS, SLAANESH INFANTRY or SLAANESH MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Sycophantic Surge
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, provided at least one of the targets of that charge is within Engagement Range of one or more EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units from your army.

stratagems.name: Uncanny Reactions
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SLAANESH unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Dark Apparitions
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DAEMONETTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If it arrives back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units (instead of more than 9"), provided it is also set up wholly within 8" of one or more friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units.

faq.question: While using the Carnival of Excess Detachment, for the purposes of the Daemonic Empowerment rule, if my unit already has a weapon with [SUSTAINED HITS] (e.g. Shalaxi Helbane's Pavane of Slaanesh, which has [SUSTAINED HITS 3]), does an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ for such a weapon score a Critical Hit?
faq.answer: WAHAPEDIA: No answer for this question available - this is GW error.

rule.name: Pledges to the Dark Prince
rule.rules_text: At the start of the battle round, if your WARLORD is on the battlefield, you must pledge a number to Slaanesh representing how many enemy units will be destroyed this battle round. At the end of the battle round, if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than or equal to your pledge, you gain a number of Pact points equal to your pledge. Otherwise, you do not gain any Pact points this battle round and your WARLORD model suffers D3 mortal wounds. EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units from your army gain a bonus depending on how many Pact points you have gained during the battle, as shown below: 1+ Pact points: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. 3+ Pact points: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. 5+ Pact points: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1] abilities. 7+ Pact points: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

options.name: Pledges to the Dark Prince - 1+ Pact Points
options.rules_text: At 1+ Pact points, this unit can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

options.name: Pledges to the Dark Prince - 3+ Pact Points
options.rules_text: At 3+ Pact points, this unit can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

options.name: Pledges to the Dark Prince - 5+ Pact Points
options.rules_text: At 5+ Pact points, this unit's melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

options.name: Pledges to the Dark Prince - 7+ Pact Points
options.rules_text: At 7+ Pact points, Critical Hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Eternal Servitude
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, take a Leadership test for the bearer at the end of the phase. If that test is passed, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, with D6 wounds remaining (up to its Wounds characteristic).

enhancements.name: Pledge of Dark Glory
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Mortal Pain
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result if it is Battle-shocked; if failed, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Unholy Fortune
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. Once per turn, just after making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for a model in the bearer's unit, if the bearer is not Battle-shocked, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, treat the result as an unmodified roll of 6 instead.

stratagems.name: Protection of the Dark Prince
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound or attack is allocated to a model in an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Unshakeable Opponents
stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack's Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Embrace the Pain
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.

stratagems.name: Martial Perfection
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Unbound Arrogance
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.effect: Increase your pledge to Slaanesh by 1.
restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Armour of Abhorrence
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

faq.question: While using the Coterie of the Conceited Detachment, if my WARLORD is not on the battlefield, can I use the Unbound Arrogance Stratagem?
faq.answer: Yes, your pledge to Slaanesh would increase from 0 to 1.

rule.name: Internal Rivalries
rule.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER units from your army can ignore any or all modifiers to their Move characteristic and any or all modifiers to Advance and Charge rolls made for them. At the start of the battle, your WARLORD's unit is your army's Favoured Champions. The first time in each player's turn that an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, after resolving all of its attacks, that CHARACTER unit becomes your army's new Favoured Champions, replacing the old one. Each time a model in your army's Favoured Champions unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Eager to Prove
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit. While the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Repulsed By Weakness
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit Falls Back, models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests. When doing so, if the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

enhancements.name: Proud and Vainglorious
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. You can re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for the bearer's unit. While the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Slayer of Champions
enhancements.rules_text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. The bearer's melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Devoted Duellists
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One or more EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in those CHARACTER units have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Beautiful Death
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is your army's Favoured Champions. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Heightened Jealousy
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army's Favoured Champions, or just after your army's Favoured Champions unit destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: Your army's Favoured Champions unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that is not your army's Favoured Champions makes an attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Diabolic Majesty

If it does, until the end of the phase: This unit cannot target a unit it was within Engagement Range of at the start of the turn.
